_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - a shape to adapt. Copy to <repo>/.codex/hooks.json. The EVENT NAMES below are verified (Codex hooks docs, 2026-11-07); the per-hook object shape is not - read the hook schema before trusting this file, and prefer one representation per layer (hooks.json OR an inline [hooks] table in config.toml, never both: Codex merges them and warns at startup).
_intent: SessionStart -> regenerate the digest a new session would read, so it is never the stale copy
Stop -> check --all --warn: every finding surfaces, nothing blocks the turn. A Stop hook cannot undo work that already ran, and a blocked turn is an outage
non-managed hooks must be reviewed and trusted before they run, so the first install is a human step, not an agent one
whether anything DOES block is a config decision, not a decision for this file
